capabilities: Read RSS feeds and save selected articles as Markdown notes
Collect tasks from existing notes and archive completed ones
Capture daily moments with titles and images
Save web content or pasted text as notes
Set repeating reminders and open daily or recent notes
extras: The interface is primarily in Chinese. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Fetching feeds and extracting web content makes network requests to source sites; reminders only work while Obsidian is running and mobile background delivery is not guaranteed.
motivation: The author describes it as a lightweight homepage plugin built for personal use.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in start page that gathers feeds, tasks, reminders, and quick capture into a single dashboard view.

relations.evidence: Alternatively, use BRAT with this repository URL.

summary: Dashboard homepage plugin that combines RSS reading, task collection, daily moments, reminders, web clipping, and quick access to notes.
